subject: general
question: According to Airports Authority of India, which Indian airport was the busiest in terms of passenger traffic in Financial Year 2023-2024?

options.text: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, Mumbai

solution:
The correct answer is __**Indira Gandhi International Airport, Delhi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Indira Gandhi International Airport (IGIA), located in Delhi, was the **busiest airport in India** in terms of passenger traffic for the financial year 2023-2024.
 
• IGIA serves as the primary hub for major airlines, including **Air India, Vistara, and IndiGo**, connecting domestic and international destinations.
 
• In FY 2023-2024, IGIA handled a record-breaking number of passengers, surpassing **70 million annual passengers** as per Airports Authority of India (AAI) data.
 
• The airport has consistently ranked among the top in terms of passenger traffic due to its **strategic location, advanced infrastructure, and efficient operations**.
 
• IGIA also features **Terminal 3 (T3)**, one of the largest passenger terminals in the world, handling both domestic and international flights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passenger Traffic in India**

 
 
• India's aviation sector is one of the fastest-growing in the world, with a significant increase in domestic and international passenger traffic.
 
• As of FY 2023-2024, the Airports Authority of India (AAI) reported a steady recovery post-COVID-19, with several airports achieving pre-pandemic traffic levels.
 
• Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad airports are among the busiest in the country in terms of passenger and aircraft movement.
 
 
 
• **Indira Gandhi International Airport Overview**
 
 
• IGIA is managed by Delhi International Airport Limited (DIAL), a consortium led by GMR Group.
 
• The airport has three operational terminals: T1 (domestic), T2 (domestic low-cost carriers), and T3 (mixed-use for international and domestic).
 
• It has won several awards, including the prestigious **ACI Airport Service Quality (ASQ) awards**.
 
 
 
• **Key Growth Drivers for IGIA**
 
 
• Delhi's central location and connectivity to major cities within India and abroad contribute to its high passenger traffic.
 
• Ongoing infrastructure development, including the expansion of runways and terminals, ensures capacity to handle future growth.
 
• Strategic partnerships with airlines and government initiatives like the **UDAN scheme** play a pivotal role in its success.
 
 
 
• **Economic Impact of IGIA**
 
 
• IGIA is a significant contributor to the Indian economy, supporting millions of jobs directly and indirectly.
 
• The airport also serves as a hub for cargo operations, facilitating international trade and commerce.
